android.desc:
We’re excited to bring you what our users have been asking for from day one of our Comet launch: Comet for Android, the first agentic AI browser built for mobile.

• An AI assistant in your pocket: Browse like you would on Comet, with your personal AI assistant one tap away to help you ask more questions and take action on the tasks you assign it to handle. With Comet Assistant’s expanded reasoning, you can see exactly what actions your Comet Assistant is taking, and step in at any time.

• Chat with your tabs: Users love Voice Mode in the Perplexity app. We’ve brought our voice recognition technology to Comet for Android, allowing you to chat with your Comet Assistant to find information across all your open tabs.

• Summarize your searches: One of the features people love most in Comet is its ability to work across tabs to synthesize information. Smart summarization on Comet for Android gives you the ability to summarize content across all your open tabs, not just the page you have open.

• Focus on what matters: Avoid spam and pop-up ads with a built-in ad blocker. Just like Comet on your desktop, you can whitelist the sites you trust.
